name: Unidirectional Spectral Tracking
definition: A spectral volume rendering technique that samples events (absorption, scattering, null) using a majorant density and returns the path length and spectral contribution, handling Russian roulette implicitly via event selection.
summary: Unidirectional Spectral Tracking is a volume rendering technique that uses a mean-based majorant and unidirectional event selection to simplify throughput updates, differing from standard Spectral Tracking.
